mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages (sender_id, receiver_id, content, is_read) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{isRead})
mapper.select: SELECT sub.other_user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, sub.last_message AS lastMessage, sub.last_message_time AS lastMessageTime, sub.unread_count AS unreadCount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END AS other_user_id, content AS last_message, created_at AS last_message_time, SUM(CASE WHEN receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END ) AS unread_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END ORDER BY created_at DESC ) AS rn FROM messages WHERE sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId} ) sub JOIN users u ON u.id = sub.other_user_id WHERE sub.rn = 1 ORDER BY sub.last_message_time DESC

SELECT m.id, m.sender_id AS senderId, m.receiver_id AS receiverId, m.content, CASE m.is_read WHEN 1 THEN true ELSE false END AS isRead, m.created_at AS createdAt, u.username AS senderName, u.avatar AS senderAvatar FROM messages m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.sender_id WHERE (m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.receiver_id = #{otherUserId}) OR (m.sender_id = #{otherUserId} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE messages SET is_read = 1 WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
